_doc: Central env-flag registry. Owner: core/env_flags.py. Declare every PIPELINE_*/MODEL_* switch (default, purpose, owner) so behaviour is discoverable.

PF_ID_ALLOC.purpose: backlog id allocation mode: strict(default - require the shared git-CAS authority, fail closed, never self-reserve) | on(soft: CAS->API->local block) | off(legacy max+1)

PF_ID_ALLOC_REMOTE.purpose: use the shared git-remote CAS authority (refs/heads/pf-id-counter) to reserve id blocks

PF_ID_ALLOC_API.purpose: allow the PF API id-reserve authority path (fallback when the git remote is unavailable)

PF_DB_DSN.purpose: Product Forge system-of-record PostgreSQL DSN (EDP-17). Empty = DB-backed features disabled. Credentials come from this env var only (never committed).

PF_LEASE_REMOTE.purpose: assignment-lease authority mode: strict(default - require the shared git-CAS authority refs/heads/pf-leases, fail closed) | on(soft: allow offline, single-session) | off(disabled, local only)

PF_LEASE_REMOTE_REF.purpose: git ref holding the shared assignment-lease map (CAS)

PF_ID_REMOTE_REF.purpose: git ref holding the shared backlog id counter (CAS)

PF_ID_BLOCK_SIZE.purpose: ids reserved per CAS block: 1(default) = one sequential id per request (no gaps); raise for bulk creation

PF_ID_BLOCK_BASE.purpose: offline base offset for a session's local id blocks

PF_API_TOKEN.purpose: Bearer token required by the canonical api/ surface (BI-PF-1325). Canonical auth env; API_TOKEN is a deprecated back-compat alias (fail-closed when unset unless API_ALLOW_ANON=1)

API_TOKEN.purpose: DEPRECATED (BI-PF-1325) back-compat alias for PF_API_TOKEN; prefer PF_API_TOKEN

API_ALLOW_ANON.purpose: dev-only: allow unauthenticated access to the api/ surface when no token is set

PIPELINE_LLM_REPLAY.purpose: TEST-only deterministic LLM replay (BI-PF-0459): off(default) | record(persist raw responses) | replay(serve cassettes; fail-closed on miss)

PIPELINE_PRIORITY_AGING_HOURS.purpose: Scheduler fairness (P12b): hours of waiting that grant one priority level of aging (bounded to 3); 0 disables aging

PIPELINE_RATE_BUDGET.purpose: P12a provider rate budgeting: 1(default, on) = pace within provider_limits (best-effort, never blocks/aborts); 0 = disabled

PIPELINE_RATE_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS.purpose: P12a: cap (seconds) on a single pacing sleep, so pacing can never stall an agent

PF_WEB_SEARCH_BACKEND.purpose: web_search tool backend (BI-PF-0438): none(default,disabled) | whoogle | searxng | duckduckgo_html | brave | tavily

PF_WEB_SEARCH_URL.purpose: self-host search base URL for whoogle/searxng (BI-PF-0438)

PF_WEB_SEARCH_KEY.purpose: cloud search key for brave/tavily (BI-PF-0438; or use BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY / TAVILY_API_KEY)

PIDL_GATE_MODE.purpose: PIDL-3 worker-result gate mode: advisory (record the decision only) | enforce (hold non-AUTO_PROCEED closes for review/approval)

PF_AUTO_PUSH.purpose: git sync (Stage 2a): auto-push after a controlled merge / after a worker commits on its feature branch. 0 = off (explicit `sync`/push only)

API_PORT.purpose: port for the canonical api/ uvicorn server

API_ALLOW_ORIGINS.purpose: CORS allow-origins for the canonical api/ surface

A2A_ENABLE_EXPOSE.purpose: expose our agents over A2A (message/send server surface)

A2A_ENABLE_CONSUME.purpose: allow delegating to remote A2A agents (whitelisted only)

PIPELINE_PROMPT_TIMEOUT.purpose: max seconds to wait for a human prompt

PIPELINE_VERBOSE.purpose: emit verbose per-call/loop logs ([LLM], heartbeats); off = concise

PIPELINE_SECTION_CONTEXT_CHARS.purpose: cap on the assembled upstream context per section call (0 = unlimited)

PIPELINE_CAPABILITY_STEER.purpose: apply the per-agent capability vector to each LLM request (reasoning/min-output); off = unchanged

INSTANCE_TENANT.purpose: tenant a tenant-instance dashboard is bound to (tenant-scoped authz, fail-closed)

PIPELINE_AUTO_ESCALATE.purpose: auto-route a failed gate's retry to the stronger tier (model-tier ladder); off = recommendation only

PIPELINE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.purpose: sectioned agents emit compact JSON per section, rendered deterministically (BI-0224); off = prose

MODEL_GATE_REJECT_UNKNOWN.purpose: fail closed when a capability-critical agent's model fit is UNKNOWN (0 = warn only)

PIPELINE_PREFER_KIND.purpose: prefer a provider kind (direct|aggregator|self-host) when ordering LLM candidates; empty = tier order

PIPELINE_GENERATORS.purpose: enable media generation via generator adapters (BI-0188); off = detection/selection only

PIPELINE_GENERATOR_MAX_SECONDS.purpose: max wait for an async generator job (video/music/3d)

PIPELINE_GENERATOR_POLL_SECONDS.purpose: poll interval for async generator jobs

PIPELINE_FEASIBILITY_STRICT.purpose: treat a build-host 'conditional' feasibility verdict as blocking (0 = advisory)

PIPELINE_FEASIBILITY_GPU_OVERRIDE.purpose: override detected GPU VRAM (GB) for feasibility when nvidia-smi is unavailable

PIPELINE_MODEL_STRATEGY.purpose: two-phase model/capability strategy gate mode: off|warn|apply (apply writes per-agent overrides) (BI-0192)

PIPELINE_MODEL_STRATEGY_GATE_B.purpose: run Gate B (post-architect refinement) of the model strategy (0 = Gate A only)

PIPELINE_MEDIA_CONTEXT.purpose: media->agent input mode: off|summary|native (native attaches media parts when the model accepts the modality)

PIPELINE_MEDIA_SUMMARY_CHARS.purpose: cap on the media summary injected into a prompt

PIPELINE_MEDIA_BUDGET_TOKENS.purpose: per-call media token budget; over => drop least-priority parts (summary fallback) (BI-PF-0288)

PIPELINE_MEDIA_QA.purpose: media QA mode at validate: off|warn|block (BI-0191)

PIPELINE_LEARNING_AUTO_APPROVE.purpose: auto-approve learning candidates ONLY when confidence>=threshold AND scope=area (0 = always require approval) (BI-PF-0293)

PIPELINE_LEARNING_MIN_CONFIDENCE.purpose: confidence threshold for the opt-in auto-approve path (BI-PF-0293)

PIPELINE_MEMORY_READBACK.purpose: inject a bounded PRIOR RUN NOTES block from this project's memory into agent prompts (BI-PF-0294)

PIPELINE_MEMORY_CHARS.purpose: cap on the memory read-back block injected into a prompt (BI-PF-0294)

WORKER_INTEGRATION_ENABLED.purpose: runtime switch for the optional external-worker layer (registry/adapters/work-pull). 0 = disabled (PF runs unchanged; 503 on worker routes). Build-time exclude is BI-PF-0383.

PF_LEASE_RECOVERY.purpose: policy when a worker lease expires: RESUME|RETRY|REASSIGN|MARK_FAILED|REQUIRE_REVIEW

PF_WORKER_STALE_SECONDS.purpose: heartbeat age (s) after which a worker is STALE

PF_GROOMING_AI.purpose: grooming AI switch (empty=default; 0 disables AI grooming)

WORKER_AUTO_DISPATCH.purpose: automatic dispatch: assign eligible backlog items to available workers without a manual pull (0 = manual only)

WORKER_DISPATCH_POLL_SECONDS.purpose: poll interval for the optional dispatch loop

PF_PROFILE.purpose: edpsvc profile: dev|production. production refuses dev/anon auth, a weak admin token and a superuser runtime DSN.

PF_ADMIN_TOKEN.purpose: Bearer token for edpsvc /admin/* (production requires >=24 chars and not a default value).

PF_EDP_ENFORCE_LIMITS.purpose: Enable timeouts/body/quotas (0 is allowed only outside production; production refuses it).

PF_EDP_DB_TIMEOUT.purpose: DB operation timeout (must be <= request timeout).

PF_EDP_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY.purpose: Global concurrent requests (must be <= pool max).

PF_EDP_MAX_TENANT_BUCKETS.purpose: Max in-process tenant quota buckets (idle eviction + fail-closed cap).

PF_EDP_ROLE_RECHECK.purpose: Runtime DB role revalidation interval (0 disables).

PF_ALLOW_SUPERUSER_DSN.purpose: Non-production escape hatch for a superuser runtime DSN (refused in production).

PF_DEV.purpose: Development-only flag; production profile refuses it when enabled.

PF_ALLOW_ANON.purpose: Anonymized-access alias; production profile refuses it when enabled.

PF_MIGRATIONS_DIR.purpose: Migrations directory (default: nearest migrations up from cwd).

PF_MEMORY_PRINCIPAL.purpose: Server-side memory ACL principal for the admin API.
